Here's a description of the provided line plot, following the guidelines:

This plot illustrates the relationship between “Accuracy@1” and “Tree Width” for two models, GPT-4o and Claude. The x-axis is labeled “Tree Width (Number of Child Nodes)” and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 5, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 20 to 35, with tick labels at intervals of 5. A blue line, marked with circular data points, represents GPT-4o, starting at a value of 24.4 at x=1 and decreasing to 20.0 at x=5, with a peak at x=3 where the value is 34.4. A purple line, marked with cross data points, represents Claude, starting at a value of 26.7 at x=1 and decreasing to 31.1 at x=5, with a peak at x=3 where the value is 28.9.
